verdict: Google spend is underdelivering badly; Meta is carrying the load alone.
narrative: This period, you received 31 leads at an average cost of $135.76 per lead — all of them from Meta, while Google Ads spent $2,747 and produced only 2 conversions. That imbalance drove cost per lead up 60% week-over-week and pulled total lead volume down 37.5% compared to the prior 7 days. The root cause is a group of overdue setup milestones — including LSA verification, site launch, and retargeting — that have kept Google from running at full effectiveness; those blockers are being resolved now. Separately, 110 leads have entered your pipeline over the period but no appointments or won opportunities are recorded, which points to a gap in intake follow-up that we're addressing alongside the ad-side work. Next period, you should see Google begin pulling its weight as those milestones close, which will reduce reliance on Meta and bring cost per lead back down.
